rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for the major or largest part of something.

example.english: The bulk of this report was completed by interns.
example.traditional: 呢份報告嘅大部分都係由實習生完成嘅。
example.jyutping: ni1 fan6 bou3 gou3 ge3 daai6 bou6 fan6 dou1 hai6 jau4 sat6 zaap6 sang1 jyun4 sing4 ge3

rows.note: Use this for the physical volume or bulk of an object or structure, rather than a person's body.

example.english: The bulk of this piece of furniture is too large to fit in the lift.
example.traditional: 呢件傢俬體積太大，搬唔入升降機。
example.jyutping: ne1 gin6 gaa1 si1 tai2 zik1 taai3 daai6 bun1 m4 jap6 sing1 gong3 gei1

rows.note: Use this when the bulk refers specifically to a person's or animal's physical build or body size.

example.english: That basketball player's bulk makes him stand out in the crowd.
example.traditional: 嗰個籃球員身形好大，喺人群中特別顯眼。
example.jyutping: go2 go3 laam4 kau4 jyun4 san1 jing4 hou2 daai6 hai2 jan4 kwan4 zung1 dak6 bit6 hin2 ngaan5
